svg.text: DH22 core network, 2026-11-10 (v2, unclipped labels) — 28 seeds + 7 gala accounts + top 6 bridge nodes
Edges: collab graph links of ≥2 shared posts, plus every link touching a gala account. Full account names on radial labels; the canvas is sized from the label
boxes. Full scraped graph (2013 accounts, 3590 edges) is collabnet/graph/collab_graph.png in the input.
Edge colour = number of shared posts (counts: full scraped graph, as in v1)
Nodes on one circle, equal spacing; edges are interior curves. Dated copy: figure_dh22_core_2026-11-10_v2.svg
